title: **Army Spokesman: No One in History Has Been More Criminal Than US Leaders**
text:
**Army Spokesman: No One in History Has Been More Criminal Than US Leaders**"

"Brigadier General Amir Akrami-Nia, spokesperson for the Iranian Army, said:"

"- On Iran, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said: “We are facing a country that explicitly declares, ‘We target commercial ships…’ You have not seen such behavior since World War II.”"

"- “We are facing a country that, while negotiating, with utter brutality in an instant killed 168 children and a number of athletes with banned bombs, 104 sailors in a foreign country, and [people at] a wedding in the very country they were confronting.”"
"- “Have you seen such criminals from ancient times until now?”
